question: Chia theo quận đón
gold_sql: SELECT z.borough, count(y.trip_id) FROM yellow_trip y LEFT JOIN taxi_zone z ON z.location_id = y.pu_location_id WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-03-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY z.borough ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Doanh thu là bao nhiêu?
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT sum(total_amount) FROM yellow_trip WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01'), (SELECT sum(total_amount) FROM green_trip WHERE lpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND lpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01')
note: two fleets, each with its own revenue; SO_CHUYEN is the only metric over both

question: Chỉ lấy Manhattan và Brooklyn

history.text: Số chuyến taxi vàng theo quận đón tháng 2/2024

gold_sql: SELECT z.borough, count(y.trip_id) FROM yellow_trip y JOIN taxi_zone z ON z.location_id = y.pu_location_id AND z.borough IN ('Manhattan', 'Brooklyn') WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-02-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-03-01' GROUP BY z.borough ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Theo từng hãng thì sao?
gold_sql: SELECT v.name, sum(y.total_amount) FROM yellow_trip y LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.code = y.vendor_id WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01' GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: So với cùng kỳ năm trước
gold_sql: SELECT '2024' AS ky, count(trip_id) FROM green_trip WHERE lpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND lpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01' UNION ALL SELECT '2023', count(trip_id) FROM green_trip WHERE lpep_pickup_datetime >= '2023-01-01' AND lpep_pickup_datetime < '2023-04-01'
note: A5: year on year on a fleet that is shrinking; the period asked first

gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT sum(y.tip_amount) / sum(y.fare_amount) * 100 FROM yellow_trip y JOIN payment_type_code p ON p.code = y.payment_type AND p.name = 'Credit card' WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01'), (SELECT sum(g.tip_amount) / sum(g.fare_amount) * 100 FROM green_trip g JOIN payment_type_code p ON p.code = g.payment_type AND p.name = 'Credit card' WHERE g.lpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND lpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01')
